subject: CS platform hybrid licensing options & quotes
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@intercom.com>, Zoe Barnes <z.barnes@zendesk.com>, Gainsight Solutions <solutions@gainsight.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: CS platform hybrid licensing options & quotes

Team & partners —

Thanks for jumping on this. We need an actionable path for our CS & support stack for H1 2028. TL;DR: we are evaluating a hybrid approach where Intercom covers product-led chat and bot-first flows, Zendesk remains for enterprise ticketing, and Gainsight is considered for high-touch CSM workflows and renewal orchestration.

Attached is a short RFP and our current usage slices (request_for_pricing_CStoolkit.docx). Can each vendor provide:
- A price for monthly committed seats + overage model (per-seat + per-ticket)
- Any multi-product discounts if we purchase both ticketing and messaging (Zendesk + Intercom)
- Pilot terms (60-day, metrics to evaluate: CSAT, time-to-first-response, automation coverage)
- SLA baseline and data-retention / logging options for audit

Internal asks: Laura — can you pull last 6 months of ticket volumes by segment (enterprise vs PLG) and expected growth? Vanessa — summarize integrations required (SFDC, Amplitude, Analytics). Marissa — procurement bandwidth / preferred contract cadence. Ben — legal touchpoint for SLAs.

Goal: have vendor-ready quotes + legal/SLA redline suggestions by week of Nov 29 so procurement can start issuing PO/trials.

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Head of Customer Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: request_for_pricing_CStoolkit.docx

From: Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@intercom.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Zoe Barnes <z.barnes@zendesk.com>, Gainsight Solutions <solutions@gainsight.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CS platform hybrid licensing options & quotes

Camila / team —

Appreciate the brief. Attached is a preliminary Intercom quote that maps to: Messaging seats (monthly), Bot usage, and Support inbox routing for product-led flows (quote_intercom_Q412027.pdf).
Key notes:
- For organizations that keep enterprise ticketing on Zendesk, we offer a 15% cross-product discount when Intercom is tied to the same license owner and committed for 12 months.
- Pilot: we can do a 60-day pilot with rate-limited premium chat + bot tooling (no charge for first 10k bot interactions during pilot). Pilot KPIs: automation deflection, median time to first reply, and CSAT change.
- Data: we can provide logs export and a dedicated S3 delivery for events; retention adjustable up to 18 months on request.

If you can share ticket volumes (enterprise vs PLG) and estimated concurrent chat requirements, I’ll produce a refined quote.

—Ethan
Ethan Liu
Strategic Accounts, Intercom
ethan.liu@intercom.com

Attachment: quote_intercom_Q412027.pdf

From: Zoe Barnes <z.barnes@zendesk.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@intercom.com>, Gainsight Solutions <solutions@gainsight.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Nov 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CS platform hybrid licensing options & quotes

Hi all —

Thanks for the outline, Camila. From Zendesk’s side I’ve included a compact pricing breakdown (zendesk_pricing_breakdown.xlsx) showing: standard Support Suite per-agent pricing, add-ons for enterprise SLA routing, and options for a shared routing layer if you keep Intercom as the ingestion channel for PLG customers.

A couple of things you might find useful:
- If Zendesk remains the primary canonical ticket store for enterprise accounts, we can reduce the per-agent rate for agents that only handle escalations (not full-time tickets) — effectively a "reviewer" seat at ~60% of list.
- We offer a combined billing agreement for multi-product customers that consolidates invoices and unlocks volume credits after year-one.
- Pilot suggestion: run Intercom + Zendesk dual-write for 60 days, then evaluate reconciliation effort.

Happy to jump on a short call to walk the sheet.

Best,
Zoe Barnes
Enterprise EMEA & NA, Zendesk
z.barnes@zendesk.com

Attachment: zendesk_pricing_breakdown.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CS platform hybrid licensing options & quotes

Team —

I pulled the numbers (summary attached: procurement_summary_2027-11.pdf). High level:
- Last 6 months: 68k total inbound contacts. ~22% enterprise tickets (higher avg handle time), 58% PLG chat/email, 20% self-serve/automated. Peak concurrent chats ~420.
- Expected growth: +18% next 12 months under current product roadmap.

Recommendation draft for procurement:
1) Pilot Intercom for PLG messaging (60 days) with the pilot KPIs Ethan suggested. Track automation deflection and median TTF.
2) Preserve Zendesk for enterprise ticketing; negotiate reviewer-seat discounts and consolidated billing.
3) Engage Gainsight for a 90-day CSM pilot on top accounts if Gainsight can demonstrate renewal workflow improvements (we need concrete RETURN-ON-EFFORT metrics).

Action items:
- Vanessa: enumerate integration effort (SFDC field mapping + Amplitude events) and estimated eng hours (E: 4-6 sprints).
- Marissa: confirm procurement timeline & PO process for pilots (any vendor onboarding windows).
- Ben: start SLA template + list of non-negotiables for security & retention.

If we agree, I’ll ask procurement to issue vendor POs and request final redlines.

Laura Bennett
Manager, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: procurement_summary_2027-11.pdf

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@intercom.com>, Zoe Barnes <z.barnes@zendesk.com>, Gainsight Solutions <solutions@gainsight.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Procurement (Acme Legal) <procure@acme-legal.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CS platform hybrid licensing options & quotes

Thanks, everyone — good progress. Next steps from Redwood:

1) Vendors: please provide final, signed quotes that reflect the following by Dec 10: committed seats + overage model, any multi-product credits, and the pilot terms we discussed (60 days for Intercom/Zendesk dual-run; 90 days optional for Gainsight with success criteria).

2) Legal/Procurement: Ben & Marissa will send a short SLA & vendor security checklist to each vendor for redline. Vendors, please be prepared to accept standard Redwood security addendum or propose minimal changes. I’ve attached an initial redline request for Gainsight as an example (redline_gainsight_sla.docx).

3) Internal: Laura & Vanessa — prep the integration plan and a short runbook for the pilot. We want a light-weight rollback plan if automation causes regressions.

If there are constraints on pricing timelines or special approval steps needed for discounts, flag them now so we can coordinate procurement approvals.

Camila Reyes
Head of Customer Operations
Redwood Inference
